# Spiking_Topology_Optimization

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The joint optimization of both the network's connectivity structure (topology) and its spiking parameters to achieve task performance. Bridges TCC and iNEST by showing that topology-aware training can improve SNN efficiency and accuracy on neuromorphic substrates.
